Name: Tractor Skins Mod
Author: mariachaaan
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#d84d75]Tractor Skins Mod[/color]
[/b][/size]
Tractor Skins Mod is a SMAPI companion mod for Pathoschild's Tractor Mod.
It lets you switch tractor looks in-game without replacing files manually.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6001/6001-1588764278-1743068615.gif[/img]


[color=#d84d75][b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI and load your save.
[*]Press [i][b]ESC[/b][/i] (or [b][i]E[/i][/b]) to open the in-game menu.
[*]Go to the [b][i]Options [/i][/b]tab (controller icon).
[*]Scroll down and click [b][i]Mod Options[/i][/b] (this button appears if [b][i]GMCM[/i][/b] is installed).
[*]Select [b][i]Tractor Skins[/i][/b].
[*]Click the tractor skin card you want.
[*]Click [b][i]Save [/i][/b]or[b][i] Save & Close[/i][/b].
[*]Return to gameplay; your selected skin is applied by the mod.
[/list]
[b] ﻿Optional:[/b] enable `Seasonal Skin Set` and choose one skin for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
﻿ ﻿[b]Optional: [/b]enable `Daily Randomizer` to auto-select one random skin per in-game day.


[color=#d84d75][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/color]

[b]Requirements[/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]Tractor Mod
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list]

[b]Steps[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.
[*]Install Pathoschild's Tractor Mod.
[*]Download and unzip Tractor Skins.
[*]Place the folder in your [color=#d84d75]Stardew Valley/Mods[/color] directory.
[*]Launch the game once to generate or update config, then pick your skin in GMCM (or edit config.json).
[/list]
